<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When you have to deduce how things are connected,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Psyche Taxi<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will start up.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The objective of this mode is to gather the <CLT=cltSTRONG>letter
cubes<CLT=cltSYSTEM> lying around to form the question.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Use the <PAD=【○】> button to accelerate
and the <PAD=【Ｌ⇔】> stick to move left and right.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>By picking up <CLT=cltSTRONG>letter cubes<CLT=cltSYSTEM> floating around,
you can <CLT=cltSTRONG>complete the question<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Once you've completed the question, you head
toward the <CLT=cltSTRONG>escort<CLT=cltSYSTEM> that has the correct answer...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If it's the right answer, they'll get in your car.
If it's the wrong answer...something bad happens.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Also, there will be <CLT=cltSTRONG>other cars<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
on the road.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you hit those, you will take
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Focus Energy<CLT=cltSYSTEM> damage.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If it's getting dangerous, use <PAD=【Ｒ１】> to <CLT=cltSTRONG>concentrate<CLT=cltSYSTEM>,
stay calm, and <CLT=cltSTRONG>avoid them<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Please drive safely! Enjoy the ride!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Please respond at your earliest
convenience.
